Windows OS makerMicrosoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) is scheduled to report its Q3 2017 earnings on April 27th, after the bell. Analysts have anaverage earnings estimate of $0.70 Non-GAAP EPS on revenue of $23.62B. The Redmond, Washington-based tech giant is an old name, but has been out of favor with investors in the recent past. However, Microsoft is back in limelight after its decent double-digit gains in 2016. Microsoft shares have risen by an impressive 30% in the last 12 months, under the leadership of Satya Nadella. The software giant’s stock closed at an all-time high of $67.53 in yesterday’s (April 24) trade. The stock has remained mostly flat after its post Q2 earning gainsbut has gathered significant momentum ahead of Q3 earnings leading to new all-time highs. Shares of the tech behemoth have risen by more than 3% in the last five trading sessions with YTD gains of 8.7%. Microsoft shares are known to make big moves after announcing earnings. So, the question now is whether MSFT stock will maintain its strong momentum after its earnings report. Is MSFT stock a good buy at it’s all time highs, just ahead of earnings? Hot Tech Stocks To Buy Right Now: Inphi Corporation(IPHI)
 Roberto Pedone]
Inphi (IPHI) provides high-speed analog and mixed signal semiconductor solutions for the communications, datacenter and computing markets. This stock closed up 4.7% at $13.25 in Monday’s trading session.
Monday’s Volume: 838,000
Three-Month Average Volume: 202,080
Volume % Change: 378%
From a technical perspective, IPHI jumped higher here right above some near-term support at $12.44 with heavy upside volume. This stock has been uptrending strong for the last five months, with shares soaring higher from its low of $8.62 to its intraday high of $13.85. During that uptrend, shares of IPHI have been consistently making higher lows and higher highs, which is bullish technical price action. That move briefly pushed shares of IPHI into breakout territory, since the stock flirted with some near-term overhead resistance at $13.50.
Traders should now look for long-biased trades in IPHI as long as it’s trending above some near-term support at $12.44 and then once it sustains a move or close above its new 52-week high at $13.85 with volume that hits near or above 202,080 shares. If we get that move soon, then IPHI will set up to enter new 52-week-high territory, which is bullish technical price action. Some possible upside targets off that move are its next major overhead resistance levels at $14.79 to $16.94, or possibly even $18. [By Paul Ausick]
